payout_quote: Clinical Research Study of an Investigational Medication in Healthy Volunteers. San Antonio, TX. Up to $21000. Participation in this study includes 1 screening visit, 1 stay of 8 nights, 2 stays of 1 night and 6 follow-up visits. Male/Female, Age 18-65. ICON is conducting a study for healthy men and women ages 18-65. Volunteers must be available for 1 stay of 8 nights, 2 stays of 1 night and 6 follow-up visits. Qualified study participants may earn up to $21,000 for participation. Must arrive 30 minutes before your scheduled screening appointment to complete paperwork. Even if you do not qualify, you may receive up to $300 for referring a qualified participant.
steps: Open the ICON studies page and locate the San Antonio study (Study 767 / 2758C).
Click Apply Now and schedule a screening appointment (arrive 30 minutes early for paperwork).
Pass the screening and the study's eligibility criteria (healthy men and women ages 18-65, BMI 18.5-30).
Complete the full schedule: the 8-night stay, two 1-night stays, and all 6 follow-up visits.
Qualified participants may earn up to $21,000 for participation.
catches: Only healthy men and women ages 18-65 meeting strict criteria (BMI 18.5-30, smoking limits) qualify; you must pass screening — not everyone qualifies.
The $21,000 is an 'up to' ceiling tied to completing the full schedule; late arrivals at screening may not be seen.
Heavy time commitment: an 8-night inpatient stay plus two 1-night stays plus 6 follow-up visits.
You receive an investigational medication with real medical risks and side effects disclosed in informed consent.
biggest_catch: Up to $21,000 requires an 8-night inpatient stay plus two overnight stays and 6 follow-up visits, passing strict healthy-volunteer screening (ages 18-65, BMI 18.5-30) — and receiving an investigational medication with real side-effect risks.
eligibility: Healthy men and women ages 18-65; BMI 18.5-30; smokers allowed only up to 10 cigarettes/day equivalent; must pass screening.
timing: Compensation paid to qualified participants for participation in the study.

notes: ICON official volunteer domain iconstudies.com lists multiple current stipend-stated studies (verified live 2026-09-23). Representative study 767 (San Antonio): up to $21,000, 8-night stay + two 1-night stays + 6 follow-up visits. Salt Lake City listings run even higher (e.g., $27,500). Framed honestly: strict screening gate, investigational-medication risks, multi-week commitment.
payout_value_note: Official ICON study page states 'Up to $21000' for Study 767; no floor stated.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($21,000 ceiling); time: ACTIVE minutes only - screening (~210 min, incl. arriving 30 min early) + 6 follow-up visits (~45 min each) + check-ins/check-outs (~180 min). The 10 inpatient nights are a dominant additional commitment called out in catches.
